question: What constitutes the lowest grade of worship in this threefold scheme?
premises: Worship may consist only of merit-union
This form lacks fuller ritual elements
It is classified as the lowest
inference: Worship consisting only of merit-union should be considered the lowest.
uncertainties: puṇyayogaṃ may refer to a simple meritorious observance
plain_english: But worship consisting only of merit-union should be the lowest.
